chapter: Closing: recent career, family and travel
title: Family, marriage and temperament
summary: His 16-year-old daughter changed his life; he was once temperamental and walked off jobs.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Well, it's a good goal, a good turning point. Right now my lifestyle has been not too stable, you know, with my matrimonial thing. But right now I seem... I am very happy now; more happy than I've been in quite a while. But I don't know, it might offer me the opportunity to write...you know, the opportunity to be by myself and do the things I like to do.
Oh yeah. That's the second time around, you know. She's for the dance. She's been good...
Did you have any children by your first marriage?
No, I never had any before. I was very happy-
go-lucky. Having an offspring, it makes a difference in your life.
I think so. I think it can be a comfort to you as you grow older, you know.
It could be a worry(?), too.

If I think back now to the way I used to be... You know, I didn't have the sympathy, the moral guides(?) to marry and have children, you know... If there was a job and it was a bad one and I didn't like it, I'd walk out, without thinking about what the other fellows...you know, they might have to stay there to gain their livelihood. I didn't seem to care about anything. I was called temperamental, and indeed I was. Although I had a lot of...people had a lot of respect for me.

Now, I'm bending over backward, and they say, 'Gee, is that you? You take an awful lot. That's not really you, is it?' But it's a different thing. When you have a responsibility of a family, you know...
Yeah. But also, when you're in the Jazz business and when you're traveling a lot, I always thought the idea of the guys who marry and have a home and... It's a bit hard, isn't it.
